abilities.name: clear-body
abilities.effect: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: liquid-ooze
abilities.effect: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.

abilities.name: rain-dish
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

kanto.flavorText: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

original-johto.flavorText: When its 80 feel­ ers absorb water, it stretches to become like a net to entangle its prey.

hoenn.flavorText: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It alerts others to danger by stridently flashing the red orbs on its head.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.

updated-johto.flavorText: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

original-unova.flavorText: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.

updated-unova.flavorText: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.

kalos.flavorText: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Tentacruel has tentacles that can be freely elongated and shortened at will. It ensnares prey with its tentacles and weakens the prey by dosing it with a harsh toxin. It can catch up to 80 prey at the same time.

original-alola.flavorText: Although these Pokémon are rare, when a large outbreak of them occurs, all fish Pokémon disappear from the surrounding sea.

updated-alola.flavorText: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it’s a warning sign.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.

swsh.flavorText: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.

pla.flavorText: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.
